review.images: Verified Emaar’s seven gallery views and original wide hero. Kept seven distinct scenes after removing the repeated entrance crop. The entrance also supplies the listing card, with the living room and bedroom in the interior section.
review.location: Checked the named Club Place pin, the developer’s Dubai Hills Estate regional map and the official brochure’s four regional travel estimates on physical page 3. The Blue Line is marked future.
review.floorPlans: Reviewed the original 39-page pack, including the massing diagram and 37 unedited layout sheets. Checked the tables visually and against independent text, including eight printed range groups on six sheets. BGO4 on physical page 26 is retained as printed. CG03 on physical page 39 prints 1,281.01 sq ft while the parts add to 1,281.04 sq ft. Kept the printed figure with an explicit note.

unavailable: The specific building entrance, signed unit areas and current journey times require confirmation.
